issue.title: Repeats MCP endpoint omits its actual 409 IMAGING_ORDER_STATE_INVALID refusal
issue.actual: On a fresh owned synthetic Ordered XRay order11, POST /imaging/orders/11/repeats with reason Positioning/exposures1 correctly refuses409 IMAGING_ORDER_STATE_INVALID, message 'Repeats are recorded for an examination that was performed'. Current get_endpoint/get_screen_bundle/screen_test_plan only list VALIDATION_ERROR422 for this endpoint and omit the stage refusal. The backend stage guard itself is correct; this is a knowledge/error/test-plan completeness issue, not a clinical product defect.
issue.expected: Document this endpoint's IMAGING_ORDER_STATE_INVALID409 in its MCP errors/detail and test plan, including rereading the original order and reviewing its stage before another action. Screen rule explicitly permits only InProgress/Completed/Reported. The frontend already guards those stages and displays actual server refusals; implementation is not blocked.
issue.steps: Read current get_endpoint POST /imaging/orders/{order_id}/repeats and imaging_repeats bundle/test plan. As demo.doctor create a clearly synthetic XRay on an owned paid/unlocked synthetic ticket. Before starting it (Ordered), as demo.radiographer POST its repeats route with reason Positioning, exposures1 and a synthetic note, original idempotency key. Verify409/code/message and no repeat effect. Do not replay our completed source or create a real exposure.
